map.对公关活动从策划到执行再到评估的全流程进行结构化评分，涵盖目标设定、预算管理、受: A structured score of the whole PR event process from planning through execution to evaluation, covering six dimensions: goal setting, budget management, audience analysis, channel strategy, execution quality and effect evaluation.
map.📖 查看「活动（策划/执行/评估）全案 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Event (Planning/Execution/Evaluation) Full Plan'
map.公关活动全案评分 = 目标设定 + 预算管理 + 受众分析 + 渠道策略 + 执: PR event full-plan score = goal setting + budget management + audience analysis + channel strategy + execution quality + effect evaluation (0 to 5 points each, 30 in total); 25 or above is excellent, 20 to 24 is good, 15 to 19 is qualified, and below 15 is unqualified, requiring the planning scheme to be re-evaluated.
map.评估涵盖策划、执行、评估三大阶段的6个核心维度: The assessment covers 6 core dimensions across the three stages of planning, execution and evaluation
map.建议在活动结束后1-2周内完成评估，确保数据准确: Complete the evaluation within 1-2 weeks after the event ends to ensure the data is accurate
map.总分25分以上为优秀，20分以上为良好: A total score above 25 is excellent, and 20 or above is good
map.单项低于3分的维度需重点关注改进: Dimensions scoring below 3 need focused attention and improvement
map.一场线下活动收官后，按目标设定、预算、受众、渠道、执行、效果 6 个维度各打 0: After an offline event wraps up, score 0-5 on each of the six dimensions of goal setting, budget, audience, channel, execution and effect to quantify the quality of the whole plan.
map.同一活动在策划稿（事前）与复盘（事后）两次评分对比，看执行是否打折。: Compare the scores of the same event at the planning stage (before) and the review (after) to see whether execution fell short.
map.把多个活动的评分做横向排名，识别哪类活动（发布会/快闪/沙龙）稳定高分、可复制。: Rank the scores of multiple events horizontally to identify which event types (launch/pop-up/salon) consistently score high and are reproducible.
map.6 个维度各 0~5 分：①目标设定 ②预算管理 ③受众分析 ④渠道策略 ⑤执行: 6 dimensions, 0-5 points each: ① goal setting ② budget management ③ audience analysis ④ channel strategy ⑤ execution quality ⑥ effect evaluation; total = the sum of the six, 30 in total. Grades: ≥25 excellent, ≥20 good, ≥15 qualified, <15 unqualified.
map.某发布会评分 目标5+预算5+受众4+渠道5+执行5+效果4 = 28 分，判优: A product launch scores goal 5 + budget 5 + audience 4 + channel 5 + execution 5 + effect 4 = 28 points, judged excellent (≥25), and the tool suggests 'reuse it as a benchmark case'. By contrast, a hastily organised market scores goal 2 + budget 2 + audience 1 + channel 2 + execution 1 + effect 1 = 9 points, judged unqualified (<15), and the tool suggests 're-evaluate the planning scheme'. The gap between 28 and 9 comes mainly from audience analysis and execution quality, which are the review focus.
map.评分维度权重都一样吗？: Are the scoring dimensions all weighted equally?
map.本工具等权（每项 0~5、共 30）。实际管理中效果评估往往更关键，若你要加权（: This tool uses equal weights (0-5 each, 30 in total). In real management effect evaluation is often more critical; if you want to apply weights (e.g. effect at 30%), adjust the weights yourself when interpreting the total, or reflect the weight difference in the sub-scores. Equal weights suit quick horizontal comparison.
map.不合格的活动数据能直接对外汇报吗？: Can data on unqualified events be reported externally as is?
map.不建议直接对外。不合格分通常表示「达到基本标准需改进」甚至「存在较大问题」，对内: It is not recommended. An unqualified score usually means 'meets the basic standard but needs improvement' or even 'has substantial problems'; internally it is review input, while externally you should present the improved version or a desensitised summary of results. The scores from this tool serve only as an internal quality benchmark.
